name: fooyin-tapeout
summary: A native Tapedeck plugin for fooyin, so the player reports what the ListenBrainz wire format has no field for. Early but working — listens, skips, now-playing and an offline queue that survives a restart have all been exercised against a real fooyin 0.12.6 and a live Tapedeck, on one configuration: Fedora 44 (Sway), x86-64.
adds: Measured audio quality, the output device, real skips, and the MusicBrainz work, release-group, release-track and album-artist ids a generic scrobbler drops
